task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands the agent to be holding the key on at least two different moves, but the only Existence clause is the hard ExistenceTwo(has_key), which requires only one occurrence; add a second hard Existence clause for the second key hold. The task also requires the agent to open the door and reach the goal after acquiring the key, but the only Precedence clause is the hard Precedence(door_open, has_key), which requires the door to open before the key is acquired; add a second Precedence clause to require the door to open before the goal is reached. The task is not rule-only, because it requires the agent to reach the goal after opening the door, so the machine needs a final state. The rule-only warning is a hint to check if the task is really rule-only.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires to be holding the key on at least two different moves, but no clause makes it happen. The task also requires opening the door and reaching the goal in that order, but the current machine does not enforce this order. Add a hard ExistenceTwo(has_key) and a hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal) to the machine. The hard Precedence(door_open, has_key) is already implied by the other hard rules, so it can be removed. The redundant clause can be removed as well. The hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal) already implied by the other hard rules can be removed.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires at least two moves with the key, but only one clause makes it happen; ExistenceTwo is correct, but the task wording makes it a hard requirement. Add another hard Existence(a) with the same propositions as ExistenceTwo, for every other move required by the task. The task also requires opening the door and reaching the goal, but no clause makes it happen. Add a hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal) with door_open and at_goal in the correct order. This will also make reaching the goal happen, so remove the redundant Existence(at_goal) from the task.
